parameters.name: DefenseScene
parameters.description: The protection scenario of the protection template. For more information, see the valid values for the **DefenseScene** parameter in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~) when **DefenseType** is set to **template**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of your WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object that you want to query. You can specify this parameter to filter the results.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the protection template.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the protected objects that can be associated with a new protection template for the specified protection scenario (**DefenseScene**) are returned.
